scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install greenlet
